text.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ

words.gloss_range: masculine plural relative pronoun continuing and defining the warned group through following predicates

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the zakah due withheld in the first predicate
the afterlife domain denied in the second predicate

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not restart the discourse with a fresh noun. It holds the warned group from 41:6 open until the predicates arrive, so the class is defined by two joined marks: they do not render {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}), and they are deniers with respect to {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}). The expansionary variant evidence is useful only as contrast: the canonical relative head compresses the identifying force into the following clauses rather than spelling it out independently.

topics.headline: relative head waits for predicates
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the warned group is grammatically defined by conduct and creed rather than by a new label.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun introduces a descriptor, and the attachment evidence warns that it continues the target from 41:6 rather than opening an unrelated subject.

topics.headline: compressed continuation of the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the standard wording compresses cross-boundary identification into one relative head while still apposing the prior warning.
topics.reason: The appositional continuation is locally supported, while the expansionary variant can illuminate compression but cannot govern the canonical parse.

words.gloss_range: negative particle scoping over the imperfect giving verb

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the imperfect verb governed by negation
the definite object left intact by the negation

words.prose: {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) removes the act, not the due. Its scope falls on {{ar:يُؤْتُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾtūna}}), so the definite {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}) remains a recognized obligation while the group's rendering of it is absent. Because the negated verb is imperfect, the failure reads as a live or characteristic nonperformance, and its placement lets the listener meet the missing transfer before the withheld object is named.

topics.headline: negation removes the act
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known due remains intact while the group's recurring act of rendering it is negated.
topics.reason: The local support explicitly constrains the negation to the giving clause and not to the later afterlife-denial clause.

topics.headline: absence is heard before the due
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the clause staging: first a missing action, then the definite object whose transfer has disappeared.
topics.reason: The independent negative particle visibly precedes the imperfect verb, and the object follows after the negated act.

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect plural causing something to reach or be rendered, here negated with an explicit zakah object
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-t-y ranges around coming, arriving, bringing, and giving; the local Form IV selects caused transfer while negation blocks that caused arrival

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the direct object that should be made to reach
the negative particle governing the verb
the connector and pronoun that open the worldview clause

words.prose: {{ar:يُؤْتُونَ}} ({{tr:yuʾtūna}}) makes the failure dynamic. The Form IV shape turns the root's arrival field into caused delivery: {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}) is the thing that should be made to reach its proper effect, and {{ar:لَا}} ({{tr:lā}}) says that arrival does not happen. The plural imperfect spreads the failure across the same group as an ongoing profile, not a single completed lapse. The internal hamza adds a small catch inside the transfer verb, making the sound surface interrupt the flow the word should cause. The wording also reverses the familiar rendering-zakah formula seen at 2:43, while its place before {{ar:وَهُم}} ({{tr:wa-hum}}) lets conduct open into the worldview clause; 41:8 then answers this non-act with positive righteous action.

topics.headline: plural imperfect profiles a pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the non-rendering is distributed across the group as a continuing profile.
topics.reason: The verb carries third masculine plural agreement and imperfect aspect, with the relative pronoun supplying the discourse referent.

topics.headline: caused arrival is blocked
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices withholding as arrested arrival: a due is not made to reach where it should work.
topics.reason: The local Form IV verb has an explicit direct object, so the arrival field is selected as caused transfer rather than bare coming.

topics.headline: known giving formula is reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a recognizable zakah-rendering formula is present as a marked absence rather than as obedience.
topics.reason: The contextual data supports a recurrent Form IV giving plus zakah association, and the row's 2:43 reference is usable as formulaic contrast.

topics.headline: conduct opens into worldview
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negated action is the first diagnostic beat before the ayah names the stance behind it.
topics.reason: The verb sits in the first relative clause before the circumstantial nominal clause, and 41:8 supplies a nearby contrast with positive righteous action.

topics.headline: hamza catches inside the transfer
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a small sound-break inside the very verb whose meaning would make the due arrive.
topics.reason: The sound observation is form-specific and does not conflict with the local parse.

words.gloss_range: the definite zakah due, functioning as the direct object whose rendering is negated
words.root_gloss_range: z-k-w includes growth, increase, purity, rectitude, and the known zakah due; local grammar selects the due while preserving growth-purity pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the final denial predicate contrasted with zakah's purifying field

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}) names the concrete object withheld. Its definiteness makes the charge a breach of a recognized due, and its accusative object role keeps attention on what fails to be rendered even though no recipient is named. The article assimilates into the zay and the doubled consonant compresses the sound before the long vowel opens, so the known due is audible as a defined pressure point. The z-k-w field brings growth and purification together, so the refusal blocks not only a payment but a channel of purifying increase. The noun also stands against {{ar:كَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}): cleansing and growth are set beside covering denial. The tazakkā success echo at 87:14 sharpens the inverse, because here the social due that should enact purification does not circulate.

topics.headline: known due is the withheld object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the failure concerns a definite obligation, not optional generosity or a vague ethical topic.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, feminine singular, and accusative as the explicit object of the negated Form IV verb.

topics.headline: growth and purity load the due
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the selected zakah due carries growth and cleansing pressure while local grammar keeps it a transferable object.
topics.reason: V4 supports growth, purity, and the known zakah-due branch; suitability, even-number, and review branches are not locally selected.

topics.headline: withheld purification meets covered finality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that zakah-refusal is paired with afterlife-denial and set against the success-purification field at 87:14.
topics.reason: The rows preserve a recurrent giving-zakah field, a local zakah-afterlife pairing, and an explicit 87:14 contrast without overriding the local object role.

topics.headline: definiteness is audible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the article and doubled consonant making the known due feel compressed into the word's sound.
topics.reason: The phonetic rows are form-specific and support the same definite-due payoff rather than adding a separate lexical branch.

words.gloss_range: coordinating and circumstantial connector binding the conduct clause to the worldview clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the attached connector-pronoun sequence introducing the state clause

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge from social non-rendering to worldview. It coordinates two diagnostic clauses, but in {{ar:وَهُم}} ({{tr:wa-hum}}) it also works circumstantially: the denial of the final horizon accompanies and explains the refusal to render the due. Its graphic attachment to the following pronoun makes the transition compact, keeping both clauses under one profile of the same warned group.

topics.headline: connector binds act and state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that afterlife denial is not a detached second fact but the accompanying state behind the non-rendering.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence licenses the second clause as coordinated and circumstantial, linked to the non-giving clause.

topics.headline: same class stays attached
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the connector prevents the second clause from becoming a new topic with a different referent.
topics.reason: The proclitic connector is graphically attached to the pronoun and syntactically links the nominal clause to the same relative descriptor.

words.gloss_range: independent third masculine plural pronoun opening the circumstantial nominal clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fronted prepositional phrase naming the denied domain
the second pronoun resuming the same group

words.prose: {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}) keeps the same people in view as the ayah changes from a negated action to a nominal worldview clause. Because the pronoun is independent, the fronted phrase {{ar:بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:bi-l-ākhirati}}) can be foregrounded without replacing the subject. It also prepares the second {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}), so the denied domain is bracketed by the same group on both sides.

topics.headline: same group opens the state clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that zakah-refusal and afterlife-denial belong to the same group, not to two syntactic subjects.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject of the coordinated circumstantial nominal clause.

topics.headline: pronoun frame anticipates resumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first pronoun preparing a repeated-pronoun frame around the fronted afterlife phrase.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun begins the clause and the later independent pronoun resumes it after the fronted prepositional phrase.

words.gloss_range: bound preposition governing the afterlife noun as the domain of denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the governed noun naming the denial domain
the predicate to which the prepositional domain attaches

words.prose: {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}) fastens the denial to its exact domain. It governs {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) and binds that phrase to {{ar:كَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}), so the clause is not vague denial but denial with respect to the final horizon. Its clitic liaison carries directly into the governed noun in recitation, making the prepositional relation audible. Because the bound prepositional phrase is fronted before the predicate, the listener meets what is being covered over before the denier-label lands.

topics.headline: preposition fixes the denial domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denial is precisely attached to the Hereafter as its object-domain.
topics.reason: The attachment evidence marks the preposition as governing the afterlife noun and relating it to the active participle predicate.

topics.headline: fronted phrase foregrounds finality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disputed final horizon arrives before the predicate label and is audibly bound to the preposition.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase is graphically and phonologically bound to its noun and positioned before the predicate.

words.gloss_range: the definite final realm, governed by the preposition as the domain of denial
words.root_gloss_range: ʾ-kh-r covers lateness, being last, delay, and final outcome; the local noun selects the recognized final realm of accountability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preposition governing the afterlife noun
the denial predicate whose domain is the Hereafter

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:al-ākhirati}}) is genitive after {{ar:بِ}} ({{tr:bi}}), so it is the governed domain of {{ar:كَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}), not a loose topic or predicate. Its definiteness makes the final realm recognizable, and the ʾ-kh-r sequence field turns lateness into consequence: denial refuses the horizon that would evaluate present action. The hamza gives the fronted domain a glottal catch as the clause turns from present possession to final consequence. The fronted phrase makes the clause revolve around that final horizon before the denier-label arrives. The same horizon is echoed by the true-life formula at 29:64, recurs in the surah at 41:16 and 41:31, and is immediately answered by durable reward language in 41:8.

topics.headline: definite Hereafter is governed domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the recognized final realm is the exact governed content of denial.
topics.reason: The noun is definite, genitive after the preposition, and attached as the domain complement of the denial predicate.

topics.headline: lastness becomes accountability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the laterness field becomes a named realm of consequence, not mere chronological distance.
topics.reason: No V4 root rows are available for ʾ-kh-r, but the local noun and denial predicate select final accountability rather than a verb of postponement.

topics.headline: fronting makes finality central
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that finality is foregrounded before the predicate, shaping how the denial label lands.
topics.reason: The prepositional phrase interrupts the path from subject to predicate and precedes the repeated subject plus predicate.

topics.headline: denied horizon enters a larger thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the denied final horizon is answered nearby and belongs to a wider afterlife formula field.
topics.reason: The rows provide concrete references to 29:64, 41:16, 41:31, and 41:8, and those references support echo and contrast without controlling the local parse.

topics.headline: sound break marks the domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a glottal catch inside the fronted domain phrase as the clause turns from present conduct to final consequence.
topics.reason: The phonetic observation is local to the afterlife noun and reinforces the fronted-domain topic.

words.gloss_range: repeated independent third masculine plural pronoun resuming and emphasizing the subject before the predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the fronted phrase after which the subject is resumed
the first pronoun echoed by the second pronoun

words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) restarts the subject after the fronted {{ar:بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ}} ({{tr:bi-l-ākhirati}}). That resumption lets the Hereafter be foregrounded without letting the predicate drift away from the accused group. Because it repeats the earlier {{ar:هُم}} ({{tr:hum}}), the same people are heard before and after the disputed domain, and the final charge lands sharply on them.

topics.headline: subject resumes after fronting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the predicate is locked back onto the same group after the fronted afterlife phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the second pronoun as resumptive and emphatic before the predicate.

topics.headline: repeated pronoun brackets the domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same group audibly bracketing the denied Hereafter with no syntactic escape.
topics.reason: The independent pronoun separates the fronted phrase from the predicate and repeats the earlier subject pronoun.

words.gloss_range: masculine plural active participle functioning as the predicate: deniers with respect to the Hereafter
words.root_gloss_range: k-f-r ranges from covering and concealment to religious denial, ingratitude, disavowal, and expiation; the local active participle with the afterlife complement selects culpable covering-denial

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the resumed subject with which the predicate agrees
the withheld due contrasted with the covering-denial predicate

words.prose: {{ar:كَٰفِرُونَ}} ({{tr:kāfirūna}}) closes the ayah as a predicate-label. As an active participle in a nominal clause, it presents a settled collective posture rather than one completed act; the plural form agrees with the resumed {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}). The k-f-r covering field makes afterlife denial an active masking of final consequence, and the nearby contrast with {{ar:ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ}} ({{tr:al-zakāta}}) sets cleansing growth against concealment. The expiation branch remains only contrastive here: the selected word names agents of denial, not covering that repairs sin. Its long participial vowel, hard kaf onset, and rolling r before the plural ending give the final predicate extra acoustic weight. The label also starts a same-surah denial thread at 41:14, 41:26, 41:27, 41:29, and 41:41, while 41:8 answers it with a believer class.

topics.headline: active participle seals identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah lands on a standing identity rather than narrating one isolated denial event.
topics.reason: The active participle is the nominative predicate of a nominal clause and agrees with the repeated plural pronoun.

topics.headline: covering becomes culpable denial
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices afterlife denial as active covering of final consequence, while repair or expiation remains outside the selected local sense.
topics.reason: V4 supports both covering and religious denial branches, but the local active participle with the afterlife complement selects denial rather than expiation, camphor, farmer, place, or other distant branches.

topics.headline: covering opposes purification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah's semantic opposition: the refused due would cleanse and grow, while the final label covers and denies.
topics.reason: The local sequence places zakah refusal and the denial predicate in one profile, and the 14:7 gratitude-kufr contrast supports the polarity without replacing the local afterlife complement.

topics.headline: closing label starts a denial thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this final label as an early node in the surah's denial chain and as the foil for the believer profile in 41:8.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows provide concrete same-surah references and the immediate 41:8 contrast.

topics.headline: sound and final position harden the seal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final predicate's length, hard onset, and closing placement making the identity-charge land firmly.
topics.reason: The participial form, plural ending, recitational length, and final position all support a closing identity-seal payoff.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ couples a negated act of ء ت ي with the growth field of ز ك و.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation blocks an outward transfer: الإيتاء supplies giving, while الزكاة supplies increase and growth. The object is therefore value whose growth depends on being rendered rather than retained.

activation_trace.role: Giving or bringing something over supplies the outward-transfer action that the negation blocks.
Increase and growth make the withheld object a growth-bearing yield rather than inert property.

changed_reading.after: They arrest a growth-bearing transfer by refusing to render what must circulate.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same لَا يُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ construction joins giving to purification and rectification.
baseline_models.mechanism: Because ز ك و also images purity and soundness, the omitted transfer is itself an available operation of repair. The failure is enacted: they decline to perform the act through which possession and possessor are put right.

activation_trace.role: Concrete giving makes purification an action to be rendered, not merely an inward quality.
Purity and rectification supply the repair that the refused act would perform.

changed_reading.after: They refuse an enacted purification that could set both wealth and self right.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ places covering directly against the later or deferred horizon.
baseline_models.mechanism: The later realm is the horizon postponed beyond the present, and كفر supplies concealment as well as doctrinal rejection. The emphatic second هُمْ makes non-giving and covering the deferred consequence two aspects of a settled posture.

activation_trace.role: Deferral to a later time supplies the consequence-horizon kept beyond immediate view.
Covering gives the denial a spatial mechanism: the delayed horizon is screened from present conduct.
Concealment of truth keeps the material image attached to the explicit unbelief construction.

changed_reading.before: They withhold zakat and, separately, disbelieve in the afterlife.
changed_reading.after: Present withholding is sustained by screening off the delayed horizon in which its consequence becomes visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence delivers and details discourse, then names covers over hearts, weight in ears, and a barrier between parties. The focus completes the circuit: nothing is admitted inward and no growth-bearing due is released outward, so كَافِرُونَ names a closed exchange system.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the blocked outward side of the exchange circuit.
Covering generalizes the several barriers into a single mechanism of closure.
Sending down and delivering supplies the attempted inward transmission.
A protective cover over the heart blocks reception at the inner boundary.
Weight in the ear blocks the auditory channel.
Prevention of access supplies the interpersonal barrier that seals the circuit.

structural_cues: 41:2-5 moves from delivered revelation to detailed signs, turning away, failed hearing, and three explicit barriers before 41:7 names non-giving and covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delivery, receptive barriers, non-giving, and covering; I infer one ingress-and-egress blockage. A live alternative is that 41:5 concerns only reception of discourse and does not govern material distribution.

changed_reading.after: They are closed at both boundaries: revelation does not enter and zakat does not leave, while كَافِرُونَ names the covering apparatus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth is made steadily fruitful and its sustenance measured for askers; heaven and earth are then told to come and answer as willing participants. Against that sequence, not giving zakat is refusal to join a creation-wide pattern of responsive provisioning.

activation_trace.role: Growth supplies the productive capacity that should become provision.
Stable, increasing good makes the earth a durable source rather than a private store.
Life-sustaining food identifies the concrete good distributed by the ordered earth.
Request and need place the provision in relation to recipients.
Readiness and compliance turn the shared ء ت ي root into responsive availability.
Willing obedience supplies the contrast with the human refusal to render.

structural_cues: 41:10 places measured sustenance explicitly toward askers; 41:11 immediately stages a command to come and the answer 'we come willingly.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies fruitful earth, apportioned sustenance, askers, and willing arrival; I infer that human giving participates analogically in that provisioning order. The live alternative is that cosmic compliance and human zakat remain parallel but separate obligations.

changed_reading.before: Non-giving is an isolated social omission.
changed_reading.after: Non-giving is refusal to participate in an ordered world where sources become fruitful, provision is measured for askers, and created domains make themselves responsive.

context_deltas.mechanism: At judgment, hearing, sight, and skins testify; the addressees are told that their attempted covering never prevented that testimony. The bodily covering itself becomes a witness, reversing كفر from successful concealment into a self-defeating forensic strategy.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the attempted concealment that the judgment scene overturns.
Declaration grounded in knowledge converts hidden conduct into evidence.
The skin as bodily envelope makes a covering surface itself testify.
Explicit covering identifies concealment as a failed human tactic.
Presence with witnessing shows why no covering can remove the event from evidence.

structural_cues: 41:19-23 moves from gathering, through sensory and skin testimony, to the explicit statement that concealment could not stop the witnesses.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cover-language and testimony by the body's outer envelope; I infer a deliberate reversal of the focus root's material image. The live alternative is that the judgment passage targets hidden deeds generally without recalling كَافِرُونَ as covering.

changed_reading.before: كَافِرُونَ is a stable identity label.
changed_reading.after: كَافِرُونَ also depicts an attempted concealment whose own surfaces preserve and disclose the evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling, doing what repairs, and دفع with what is better transform an enemy into a near, warm ally. Read back into the focus, giving the purifier is not only subtraction from wealth; it is a counter-transfer capable of cleansing a damaged social relation and closing distance.

activation_trace.role: Giving anchors the later counter-action as an outward transfer.
Purification supplies the relational repair effected by the transfer.
Repair against corruption gives the good action a restorative function.
Doing good supplies the superior medium used in the reversal.
Pushing away harm supplies the immediate defensive direction.
Delivering or giving to another opens the same act toward counter-transfer rather than mere repulsion.
Nearness without a gap measures the spatial result of the repaired relation.
Close kinship or intimacy supplies the social endpoint of the reversal.

structural_cues: 41:33-35 sequences invitation, reparative action, response with the better, enemy-to-intimate reversal, and the patience needed to carry it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a better دفع and an explicit enemy-to-intimate reversal; I infer that transfer is the mechanism connecting this scene to purification-through-giving. The live alternative is that دفع means ethical response broadly, without a distributive or zakat-specific force.

changed_reading.before: Zakat is a ledger transfer that purifies its giver.
changed_reading.after: The purifying transfer can also be read as a countergift that clears hostility and converts social distance into protective nearness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus uses ء ت ي for what people refuse to send outward; 41:40 uses the same root for how one comes safely on the day of rising, and 41:46 makes each sound act accrue to the self. The outward transfer and later arrival become opposite legs of one return circuit.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the outward leg of the circuit.
The deferred horizon supplies the temporal interval across which the transfer returns.
Coming and arriving reverse the focus root from outgoing gift to the person's later mode of approach.
Security and settled trust specify the desired quality of that arrival.
Rising and resurrection identify the deferred destination.
Intentional action supplies the conduct that travels through the circuit.
Repair and soundness qualify the action that returns beneficially.
The self as the thing itself marks the eventual recipient of its own outward act.

structural_cues: 41:40 contrasts being cast into fire with coming secure on the day of rising; 41:46 states that sound action is for the actor's own self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated ء ت ي root, secure arrival, resurrection, and reflexive accrual of action; I supply the causal return arrow from present giving to later arrival. A live alternative is rhetorical lexical recurrence without a specific causal link to zakat.

changed_reading.before: Giving now and arriving in the afterlife are separate topics.
changed_reading.after: What is sent outward now participates in how the self comes back later; refusal of outflow and denial of arrival are one broken return circuit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late human portrait never tires of calling for good, receives mercy and says 'this is mine,' doubts the Hour, turns away when favored, and resumes expansive calling when harmed. The focus condenses that asymmetry: unlimited inward demand, blocked outward yield, ingratitude, and suppression of delayed accounting.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the outward movement absent from the one-way economy.
Growth identifies the surplus that is retained rather than released.
Covering a benefit by denying or failing to acknowledge it supplies the economy's ingratitude.
Lack of weariness under repetition makes inward solicitation effectively unbounded.
Calling and drawing by speech supplies the repeated request for incoming good.
Desired benefit specifies what the inward-facing subject continually seeks.
Mercy and tenderness supply the received good that is immediately privatized.
Doubt and supposition loosen the claim of future accounting.
Ingratitude-covering names the failure to acknowledge benefaction within the same late portrait.
Favorable condition and benefaction supply the abundance after which withdrawal occurs.
Drawing the side away gives received abundance an outward posture of withdrawal.
The bodily side spatializes that retreat from reciprocal relation.

structural_cues: 41:49-51 repeats the cycle request for good, receipt, possessive claim, doubt of the Hour, withdrawal under favor, and renewed long prayer under harm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a generic human cycle of asking, possession, doubt, withdrawal, and renewed asking; I infer that 41:7 compresses the same one-way economy. The live alternative is that the late generic human type is broader than the specific group named in the focus.

changed_reading.before: Failure to give and disbelief in the later life are adjacent faults.
changed_reading.after: They form one asymmetric economy: tirelessly solicit good, privatize mercy, retreat when enriched, and screen off delayed accounting so growth need never flow back out.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ending promises disclosure in distant horizons and within selves until truth becomes clear, names doubt about encounter, and closes with total encompassing. The focus's coverers try to screen the later horizon, but the surah reverses enclosure: evidence emerges both outside and inside, and the would-be coverers are themselves encompassed.

activation_trace.role: The other or later horizon is the domain the focus subjects reject.
Covering supplies the attempted enclosure that the ending reverses.
Distant horizons expand disclosure beyond the subject's managed field.
The self itself supplies an internal site of evidence.
Emergence and disclosure move truth out of concealment.
Stable correspondence with reality names what the disclosure establishes.
Doubt and hesitation directly characterize resistance to the encounter.
Two things meeting face to face turns the later horizon into unavoidable encounter.
Complete encompassing in knowledge reverses agency: the coverers cannot stand outside the enclosing field.

structural_cues: 41:53 moves from signs in outer horizons to signs within selves and disclosure of truth; 41:54 moves from doubt of meeting to comprehensive encompassing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies outer and inner disclosure, doubted encounter, and total encompassing; I infer a reversal of the focus's cover-image. The live alternative is that the ending answers doubt epistemically without developing a spatial counter-enclosure.

changed_reading.before: The subjects cover the reality of the later life.
changed_reading.after: Their covering is trapped inside a larger field: outer horizons and inner selves disclose what they screen, and the coverers are themselves fully encompassed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates agricultural and fruit-sheath branches of ك ف ر and a yield branch of ء ت ي rather than the ordinary clause-level senses. It remains anchored in all three focus roots and is reinforced by the packet's watered-earth growth and fruit emerging from covers. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for arrested yield, not as a replacement translation of كَافِرُونَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُؤْتُونَ can image released yield, زَكَوٰة names growth, and كَافِرُونَ carries both seed-covering and fruit-sheath branches.

activation_trace.role: Emergent produce and yield recast the negated act as failure to bring growth forth.
Increase and plant growth supply the outlier's productive process.
A farmer covering seed supplies a potentially productive enclosure whose validity depends on later emergence.
The sheath around fruit supplies the image of growth still enclosed and unreleased.
Delivered water initiates the packet's explicit growth cycle.
Conveying water by irrigation or pouring supplies the channel that enables dormant growth.
Earth and vegetation stirring into life marks successful activation under the cover.
Increase and rising make released growth visible.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the decisive release movement.
Ripe fruit supplies the completed yield expected from growth.
The plant vessel and fruit wrapper give the packet an explicit sheath from which fruit emerges.

changed_reading.before: The verse labels unbelievers who withhold alms.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, they are sterile coverers: growth stays sheathed and no yield comes forth, unlike watered earth and fruit emerging from its covers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it contrasts the expiatory branch within ك ف ر with the ordinary truth-covering force of كَافِرُونَ. It remains anchored in the focus's purification and covering roots and in the immediately preceding call to seek forgiveness. Downstream prose should state a contrast among branch images, not claim that كَافِرُونَ itself means expiation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ز ك و offers purification while ك ف ر contains both truth-covering and a distinct image of covering away an offense.

activation_trace.role: Purity and rectification supply the repair being refused.
Covering truth supplies the obstructive direction actually attached to the unbelief construction.
Covering an offense until its effect is erased supplies the restorative counter-direction within the root inventory.
Covering sin while protecting its bearer supplies the adjacent offered route of repair.

changed_reading.before: They refuse purification and cover truth.
changed_reading.after: The adjacency stages opposed coverings: seek a protective covering that removes sin's effect and permits repair, or cover truth while refusing the purifying act.

strongest_changes: The focus became a closed exchange circuit: delivered signs are blocked on entry and growth-bearing zakat is blocked on exit.
Cosmic provisioning and the repeated ء ت ي root made giving an act of participation whose outward movement returns as one's later mode of arrival.
41:49-51 fused non-giving and afterlife denial into one asymmetric economy of endless asking, possessive receipt, withdrawal, and screened accounting.
Judgment testimony reversed covering into a failed forensic strategy, while the ending reversed enclosure by placing the coverers inside comprehensive disclosure.
The strongest exploratory material image was sterile covering: unlike watered earth and fruit leaving their sheaths, retained growth never comes forth.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence turned two adjacent accusations into mechanisms of blocked circulation, failed concealment, reciprocal return, and counter-enclosure; the botanical convergence at 41:39 and 41:47 was the least conservative live activation.
remaining_uncertainties: The link between cosmic provisioning and human zakat is analogical and may be thematic rather than a direct causal claim.
The agricultural and expiatory ك ف ر branches are diagnostically productive but should remain contained material contrasts in downstream prose.
The generic human cycle in 41:49-51 may illuminate rather than directly identify the group named in 41:7.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Refused release becomes arrested growth.** **ز ك و B001** supplies growth and increase, and **ز ك و B002** purity and rectitude. **ك ف ر B001/B003** supplies covering and rejection of truth. The refusal and covering are coordinated. I infer that withholding outward transfer also encloses the giver, preventing purification and growth. The ayah reads as one blocked circulation with social and eschatological faces.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:8 immediately contrasts this blockage with work whose reward is not cut off. 41:49–51 later shows the same enclosure affectively: the person endlessly calls for good, appropriates mercy, and turns away when favored.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Withholding interrupts a growth circuit.** Lexically, `ء ت ي B002` is granting or bringing, `ز ك و B001` growth and increase, and `ك ف ر B004` covering over a favor. Structurally, non-granting is followed in 41:8 by work and uncut reward, and in 41:10 by measured provisions distributed for seekers. I assign zakat the role of transferring increase outward and unbelief the role of concealing the larger temporal economy in which provision and return circulate. The inferred arrow is that retained increase becomes socially sterile when it is not passed on. The ayah thus reads as a broken circulation of bestowed growth, not an isolated omission.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 41:10’s measured provisions made the growth branch of `زكاة` more concrete: withholding interrupts a created economy already arranged to sustain seekers. 41:12’s measured cosmic order widened that economy beyond a local payment.

findings.text: Zekâtı vermemek, kendisine ulaşan artışı dışarı aktarmayı keserek hem toplumsal dolaşımı hem de verenin arınma ve gelişmesini durdurur.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It gives the exact faithful counterpart: prayer, zakah, and certainty in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It supplies a general punishment of warned rejecters, without clarifying zakah or belief in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: This exactly repeats 27:3 and adds no further understanding after that earlier counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins obstructing God's path and distorting it to disbelief in the Hereafter, expanding the focus's rejecting profile.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The nearby refusal of the messengers' call supplies a local expression of the disbelief named in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its restored command to establish prayer and give zakah adds repentance and obedience to the positive counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: This substantially repeats 11:19's path-obstruction and Hereafter-disbelief profile.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Rejecting prophetic truth in favor of idols is a distant instance of disbelief, without the focus's distinctive elements.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It presents sincere worship, prayer, and zakah as the enduring religious obligation opposite withholding zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Joseph explicitly separates himself from a people who disbelieve in God and the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Disbelief in the Reminder gives a nearby, specific object of the disbelief in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It describes rejecting what has been given while enjoying it, helping frame withholding as a response to received provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Their refusal to give people even the smallest share is a sharp practical analogue to not giving zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The question about what they worship only broadly supplies an idolatrous setting for disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: This repeats 29:66's rejection of what was given and its warning.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Giving while fearing return to the Lord closely contrasts the focus's withholding and Hereafter disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The condemned ask to confront their misleaders; it adds a later punishment scene but not the focus's cause.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Faithful worship and the warning against disbelief offer a broad contrast, but not a direct zakah or Hereafter link.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It shows how those without Hereafter faith incline to and embrace falsehood, adding a moral consequence of that disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The summoned witness and absence of excuse place disbelievers at judgment without connecting to zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It tersely states their disbelief in the message, adding little beyond the focus's declaration.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mocking the messenger while rejecting the Merciful illustrates disbelief, though it is not tied to giving or the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly challenges disbelief in a revelation from God, a nearby articulation of the focus's kufr.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command not to exalt themselves against God supplies only a general posture opposed to disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Spending from divine provision gives a concrete charitable counterpart to refusing zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Witnesses and the Book's guidance form a judgment setting, but add little to the focus's stated condition.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The promised day of the disbelievers supplies a general consequence horizon.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Dying as disbelievers after increased inner corruption adds a trajectory for the focus's kufr.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The testimony of hearing, sight, and skin at arrival supplies the nearby judgment scene for those who acted wrongly.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Turning away and disbelieving is too general to add much beyond the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prayer and zakah are joined to fear of the Day, making a close positive reversal of the focus's two omissions.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Creation not being play does not materially explain zakah or disbelief in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It concerns another's self-purification and does not clarify the focus's giving or belief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It unites belief in the Last Day, spending, prayer, and zakah in a detailed account of righteousness.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The severe recompense for disbelievers supplies the immediate consequence later developed in this surah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Their persistent denial merely restates the general disbelief already established.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The covenant's prayer and zakah command, followed by turning away, gives a communal pattern of neglected obligation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Fire's relentless character is a general punishment detail with limited incremental connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It simply describes the disbelievers as engaged in denial.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly connects lack of belief in the Hereafter with deviation from the straight path.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Its personal accounting for good and evil clarifies that the focus's consequence is not arbitrary.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies deniers of the signs as people of the left, but adds no zakah or Hereafter detail.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It pairs lack of Hereafter certainty with evil punishment and ultimate loss, complementing 27:3's faithful counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Creator's guidance does not materially clarify withholding zakah or Hereafter disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The local charge of denying the earth's Creator and making rivals identifies a form of kufr surrounding the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies a mistaken claim by those without Hereafter faith, but only indirectly concerns the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The loss of invoked protectors and the realization of no escape give a nearby consequence of false reliance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The condemnation of human ingratitude provides only a terse lexical resonance with kufr.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Showing off in worship does not by itself clarify zakah refusal or Hereafter disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The distribution of children does not add to the focus's themes.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It states recompense for disbelief but supplies no more specific connection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly assigns painful punishment to those who do not believe in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The creation and adornment of the heavens do not add to the focus's themes.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Division after clear proof is a general rejection pattern, without a direct link to zakah or the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Denial and arrogance are directly associated with lacking belief in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The address to disbelievers alone adds no particular feature of the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to remember and give thanks rather than disbelieve frames kufr as the opposite of grateful response.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Believers are characterized by prayer and giving zakah, though this repeats the positive pattern already established.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Dispute over Moses's Book and deferred judgment offer only a distant nearby parallel to rejecting revelation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's bestowal of great bounty is only an indirect background for the focus's refusal to give.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mercy is specifically written for those who are mindful, give zakah, and believe in the signs.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Divine ownership and the gift of offspring do not clarify the focus's moral contrast.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: God's independence despite universal disbelief gives a general limit on the effect of kufr.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Lack of Hereafter faith makes deeds appear fair, adding an inner mechanism for the rejecting stance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Worldly humiliation, greater Hereafter punishment, and lack of help supply the surah's consequence for rejecting people.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The contrast between believers and treacherous ingrates is broad and does not add a specific focus element.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Trading the Hereafter for worldly life, with unrelieved punishment, gives a concrete consequence of rejecting it.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The statement about human anxiety does not explain zakah or Hereafter disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The accusation of ingratitude in Pharaoh's dispute has a different social setting and adds little here.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Belief in God's signs alone is too general after the earlier positive counterparts.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The disbelievers' effort to silence the Quran supplies a nearby active form of rejecting revelation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Contentment with what God and the messenger give offers only an indirect contrast to withholding zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It includes Hereafter disbelief among false witnesses, but adds no direct link to giving or consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Exclusive worship of the Creator counters the shirk that belongs to the surrounding description of disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Bringing the truth and speaking truthfully do not materially explain the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Aversion to God's sole mention among those without Hereafter faith supplies a psychological expression of their rejection.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Aad's arrogance and denial of signs furnish a local historical example of the kufr condemned in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly warns disbelievers of severe punishment, giving a concise consequence for the focus's category.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It combines faith, prayer, zakah, and belief in the Last Day with a great reward, though it is partly redundant.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The body's testimony, first creation, and return to God deepen the local judgment account surrounding the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins prayer, zakah, lending good, forgiveness, and finding one's good with God, extending the positive practice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The hidden barrier before those without Hereafter faith adds a limited revelation-reception consequence.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: False mediation in worship and the description of a lying ingrate give a doctrinal form of kufr.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly places those without Hereafter faith in punishment and far error.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: The promise of a great reward lacks the focus's defining practices or belief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mutual care, moral action, prayer, and zakah present a communal faithful counterpart, though later and redundant.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The Fire with neither death nor reduced punishment is a direct final consequence for every persistent ingrate.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to establish prayer and give zakah is a compact positive counterpart, largely already covered.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: It distinguishes genuine purification from self-praise, but only loosely relates to zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Belief in the Last Day, prayer, and zakah characterize those who maintain the mosque, reinforcing the positive side.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The honored provision of fruit does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The challenge to produce a similar surah does not add to zakah or Hereafter disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It warns that each soul is held for its earning, without protector, intercessor, or ransom, and punished for disbelief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Past peoples' denial of messengers offers a broad historical warning with little new focus detail.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: It associates kufr with harmful learning and loss of any share in the Hereafter.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prayer and zakah are taught as good acts within prophetic leadership, but repeat an established positive pattern.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Reluctance to face battle as though led to death does not clarify the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: The demand for individual open pages does not materially connect to zakah or Hereafter belief.

inter_ayah_rows.label: no value
inter_ayah_rows.note: Mockery in response to amazement adds no specific understanding of the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: weak
inter_ayah_rows.note: Wealth used to mislead and a delayed encounter with painful punishment offer a distant contrast to right use of provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately preceding warning to idolaters supplies the local address whose description culminates in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The immediately following promise to believers who do righteous deeds gives the surah's direct positive continuation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It explicitly joins spending for display with not believing in God or the Last Day, a close negative parallel.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It directly asks what would be lost by belief in God and the Last Day together with spending from God's provision.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It joins faith, the Last Day, prayer, and zakah with secure reward, an especially close faithful counterpart.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Stinginess with God's bounty is made a burden at resurrection, directly connecting withholding to final accountability.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The covenant links prayer, zakah, and faith in the messengers, giving a communal positive obligation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Giving the due at harvest supplies a concrete form of the material obligation that withholding zakah negates.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: True believers establish prayer and spend from provision, supplying the positive pattern of response to divine gift.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Repentance, prayer, and zakah establish full communal belonging, sharply contrasting the focus's refusal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Hoarding gold and silver rather than spending it in God's way gives a direct material analogue to withholding zakah.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The hoarded wealth is heated and used against its keepers, making the consequence of non-spending concrete.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Their contributions are refused because of disbelief in God and His messenger, connecting charitable failure with kufr.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies zakah as an ordered distribution to named recipients, clarifying the social circulation absent in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Taking charity purifies and cultivates the giver, directly illuminating the zakah term in the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Giving relatives, the needy, and travelers their due concretizes the outward circulation opposed to withholding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Jesus is commanded to prayer and zakah throughout life, presenting both as enduring faithful practice.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Ishmael's command of prayer and zakah gives a prophetic precedent for the paired obligation.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Those established in the land establish prayer, give zakah, and enjoin right, extending zakah into public moral order.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The believers are specifically characterized as those who carry out zakah, the direct positive reversal of the focus.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Prayer, zakah, and obedience are tied to receiving mercy, supplying the positive outcome.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: What is given as zakah seeking God's face is multiplied, directly contrasting withholding with productive increase.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to establish prayer and give zakah reinforces the paired practice within the Prophet's household.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Whatever is spent is replaced by God, addressing the fear of loss that can underlie withholding.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The call to spend exposes the miser as harming only himself, directly explaining the self-defeating nature of refusal.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The command to spend from entrusted possessions frames wealth as stewardship rather than private possession.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: Spending before and after victory distinguishes degrees of response and gives a temporal dimension to giving.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The plea to be allowed to give charity before death makes delayed giving an urgent accountability issue.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium
inter_ayah_rows.note: The instruction to spend for one's own good identifies freedom from greed as the condition of success.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: It identifies an acknowledged due within the believers' wealth, closely clarifying zakah as an obligation rather than optional generosity.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The due in wealth is assigned to both the asking and deprived person, specifying the social recipients of giving.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Giving while being mindful and affirming the good gives a compact positive reversal of the focus's stance.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Stinginess and self-sufficiency form the contrasting moral posture that helps explain refusal to give.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: The one who gives wealth to purify himself directly illuminates zakah as purifying expenditure.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong
inter_ayah_rows.note: Withholding even small assistance supplies a concise practical analogue to refusing zakah.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi dalın çekirdeğini gelme ve ulaşma olarak doğrular; kolaylık niteliği açıklamalardan yalnız birinde belirgindir. Gelmeyi isteme ise dalın genel anlamı değil, ayrı bir kalıpta görülen kullanımdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam gelme ve ulaşmadır; gelmeyi isteme yalnız ilgili kalıba bağlıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın gelme anlamı ile birini gecikmiş sayıp gelmesini istemeyi bildiren kalıp birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ya da şeyin bulunduğu yere gelmesi veya bir hedefe ulaşmasıdır; bazı kullanımlarda bu gelişin kolayca gerçekleştiği belirtilir.

facets.statement: Bir kişi ya da şey gelir veya bir hedefe ulaşır.
Bir açıklamada gelişin kolaylıkla gerçekleşmesi özellikle belirtilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar gelme ve ulaşma çekirdeğinde birleşir; kolaylık, çekirdeği sınırlamayan ek bir niteleme olarak görünür.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin bir yere gelişi ya da hedefe varışı anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Gelme ve bir hedefe ulaşma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişinin bulunduğu yere gelişi söz konusu olduğunda doğaldır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin bir hedefe doğru gelip ulaşmasını korur.
error_profile.loses: Kişi dışındaki şeylerin gelişi ile daha genel ulaşma kapsamını dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişi veya şeyin gelmesini ve bir hedefe ulaşmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kaynak kartlarındaki çekirdek ve kapsam bakımından anlamlı bir sınır farkı yoktur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; en doğrudan eş anlamlı karşılık yayımlandı, diğerleri geliş senaryosunu paylaşsa da çekirdeği keskinleştirmedi.
branches.what_is_ar: المجيء والوصول بالذات أو بالأمر أو بالتدبير، وطلب الإتيان أو وقوع الأمر المتوقع
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الإعطاء ولا الخراج ولا ريع الزرع
branches.source_phrase_ar: أتى يأتي أتيا (jamhara)؛ الإتيان المجئ (sihah)؛ أتاني فلان إتيانا وأتيا وأتية وأتوة (tahdhib;maqayis)؛ الإتيان مجيء بسهولة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi doğrudan verme anlamını ve ikincil olarak bir şeyi getirip hazır etme kullanımını bildirir. Bu iki geçişli kullanım dal çerçevesiyle uyumludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gelme eylemini değil, bir alıcıya verme veya bir şeyi getirip sunma eylemini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın fiilin verme ve getirip sunma kapsamıyla sınırlıdır; vergi ya da başka bir kalıp anlamı içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi birine vermek; ayrıca bir şeyi getirip hazır ederek karşı tarafa sunmaktır.

facets.statement: Bir şey bir alıcıya verilir.
Bir şey getirilip hazır edilerek karşı tarafa sunulur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak çekirdek vermedir; bir açıklama aynı biçimin bir şeyi getirip hazır etme kullanımını da kapsadığını gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin alıcıya geçirilmesi veya getirilerek onun önüne konması anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Verme çekirdeğini ve getirip sunma uzantısını birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir nesne veya yararın doğrudan bir alıcıya aktarılması bağlamında en doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyi alıcıya aktarma çekirdeğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi getirip hazır ederek sunma uzantısını belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Verme eylemi bir isteğe bağlı olmadan da gerçekleşebilir ve getirip sunma kullanımını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle kendisinden istenen bir şeyi verme durumunu öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir şey bir alıcıya verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal genel verme alanına sahipken komşu dal alıcının istemiş olması koşuluyla daha dardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; istek üzerine verme dalı en yakın sınır karşılaştırmasını sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: الإعطاء، وإتيان الشيء بالشيء أو إحضاره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد المجيء ولا الإتاوة المفروضة
branches.source_phrase_ar: آتى يؤتي إيتاء في معنى أعطى (jamhara)؛ آتاه إيتاء أي أعطاه وآتاه أيضا أي أتى به (sihah)؛ الإتياء الإعطاء (tahdhib)؛ الإيتاء الإعطاء (mufradat;maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi temizlik, düzgünlük ve sakınmayı aynı ahlaki çekirdekte birleştirir; birini düzeltip arındırma, iç temizliği ve dinen uygun olup kötü sonuç doğurmayan yiyecek bu çekirdeğin bağlama bağlı açılımlarıdır. Mali payın temizleyici sayılması burada yalnız anlam ilişkisini açıklar; mali uygulamanın kendisi ayrı dalda tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal ahlaki ve manevi temizlik ile düzgünlüğü kapsar; yalın büyüme ve maldan ödenen zorunlu pay kendi dallarına aittir.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin veya iç durumun kusurdan arınıp ahlaken temiz, doğru ve sakınan bir niteliğe kavuşması ya da bir başkasının onu bu duruma getirmesidir. Yiyecek bağlamında dinen izin verilen ve sonu zarar getirmeyen olmayı da anlatabilir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, ahlaki veya manevi bakımdan temiz ve düzgün durumda olmaktır.
Bir kişinin bu niteliği taşıması, doğru davranan ve kötülükten sakınan biri olmasıyla belirginleşir.
Anlam, bir kişiyi veya iç dünyayı arındırıp düzeltme ve iyiliklerle geliştirme eylemine uzanır.
Yiyecek için kullanıldığında dinen izin verilen, iyi ve sonradan zarar doğurmayan seçeneği belirtir.
Maldan verilen zorunlu payın temizleyici sayılması, bu ahlaki temizlik alanıyla kurulan açıklayıcı bir bağlantıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım temizlik ve düzgünlüğü, kişinin sakınan niteliğini, birini düzeltip arındırmayı ve iç temizliğini birleştirir; yiyeceğin dinen uygun ve sonucu iyi olması da bağlama bağlı bir açılımdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sözcüğü çift veya iki öğeden oluşan taraf için açıkça tanımlar ve onu tek olanın karşısına koyar. Avuçta saklanan şey üzerine sorulan tek-çift sorusu ile buna eşlik eden söyleyiş, aynı karşıtlığın oyun ve tahmin bağlamındaki özel kullanımlarıdır.

Belirli bağlamlarda bir topluluğun son kesimi veya ardından hiçbir şey gelmeyen nihai varlık anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi nesnenin önüyle karşıtlanan arka bölümünü ortak çekirdek yapar ve bunu göz, semer, kumaş ve dişi devenin arka kısımlarıyla örnekler. Zamansal gecikme veya yalnızca ilkten sonra gelme bu somut bölüm anlamının yerine geçmez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın ekseni uzamsal ön-arka karşıtlığıdır; zaman bakımından gecikme, genel ötekilik ve ölümden sonraki dünya anlamları dışarıda kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak arka bölüm çekirdeğini verir; gözün köşesi, semerin dayanağı, kumaşı arkadan yarma ve devenin arka yanları gibi kullanımları kendi yapılarıyla sınırlı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Bir nesnenin ön bölümüyle karşıtlanan arka bölümü veya arka tarafıdır. Gözün şakağa yakın köşesi, semerin arka dayanağı ve hayvanın arka yanları gibi belirli yapılarda özelleşir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin önüyle karşıtlanan arka bölümü ya da arka tarafı gösterilir.
Gözde şakağa yakın arka köşe ve binek semerinde binicinin yaslandığı arka dayanak adlandırılır.
Bir nesneyi arka tarafından yarmak, arka bölüm adının ilgeçli bir yapıda kullanılmasına dayanır.
Dişi devenin öndeki iki yanıyla karşıtlanan iki arka yanı özel bir çoğul biçimle gösterilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, ön bölümün karşıtı olan arka bölümü ortaklaştırır; gözün arka köşesi, semerin arka dayanağı, arkadan yarma ve devenin arka yanları bu uzamsal çekirdeği farklı yapılarda gerçekleştirir. Semerin arka dayanağını adlandıran seyrek biçim konusunda bir aktarım biçimi reddederken diğeri kullanımı Esmaî'ye bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, dünya yaşamının karşısındaki ikinci varoluşu ve onun yurdunu açıkça tek bir yerleşik kavram olarak sunar. Bu kullanım, herhangi bir dişil sonraki biçimine veya sıradan zaman gecikmesine genellenemez.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca ölümden sonraki ikinci yaşam düzenini ve onun dünyasını kapsar; genel sonralık ve geciktirme anlamları ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, tek başına kullanılan biçim ile öteki dünyayı belirten söz öbeğini ayırırken ikisini aynı ikinci varoluş kavramına bağlar.

concept_map.definition: İçinde yaşanılan dünya düzeninden sonra başlayacağı kabul edilen ikinci varoluş ve bu varoluşun yurdudur. Tek başına kullanılan biçim, bağlamda bu yurt ifadesinin düşürülmüş biçimi olarak işleyebilir.

facets.statement: Dünya yaşamından sonra gelen ikinci varoluş düzeni anlatılır.
Bu ikinci varoluş, içinde bulunulan dünyaya karşıt bir yurt olarak adlandırılır.
Yurt adı söylenmeden kullanılan biçim, bağlam içinde ikinci yaşam yurdunu tek başına temsil eder.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tek kaynaklı kanıt, ikinci varoluş ile onun yurdunu aynı yerleşik kavramın iki anlatımı olarak verir ve yurt adının bağlamda söylenmeden bırakılabildiğini belirtir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başka bir şeyle örterek görünmesini engellemek veya kapalı duruma getirmektir. Zırhın giysiyle, kişinin silahla ya da külün savrulan toprakla örtülmesi bu işlemin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

Güneşin yıldızları görünmez kılması da görsel örtme sonucu üzerinden bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın gönderimi ekim yapan çiftçidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Gönderim örtüşse de adlandırma sınırı farklıdır: biri tohumu örtme, diğeri toprağı işleme ve meslek yönünü öne çıkarır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi günahı veya bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü belirli bir karşılıkla örtme, silme ve işlenmemiş gibi kılma sürecini açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek yalnızca bağışlama değildir; günah veya bozulmuş yemin karşısında yükü gideren bir işlem ya da karşılık bulunur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Günah yükünü giderme çekirdeği korunur; bozulmuş yemin için gerekeni yapma yalnızca ilgili söz öbeğine bağlı özel gerçekleşmedir.

concept_map.definition: Bir günahın ya da bozulan yeminin doğurduğu yükü, gereken karşılığı veya işlemi yerine getirerek örtmek, silmek ve işlenmemiş sayılacak duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Günahın yükünü örten veya silen karşılık ya da işlem.
Bozulan yemin için gereken yükümlülüğü yerine getirme, çekirdeğin yapıya bağlı özel türüdür.
İşlemin sonucu, kötülüğün işlenmemiş gibi değerlendirilmesi veya etkisinin silinmesidir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar günahın veya yeminin yükünü gideren karşılıkta birleşir; toplu anlatım hem gereken eylemi hem de günahın silinmiş sayılması sonucunu korur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Hem giderici işlemi hem de günahın etkisinin silinmesi sonucunu kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Günah yükünün bir karşılık veya işlemle ortadan kaldırılmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yemin bozulduğunda doğan özel yükümlülüğün yerine getirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bozulan yemin nedeniyle gereken karşılığın yerine getirilmesini korur.
error_profile.loses: Yemin dışındaki günah ve kötülüklerin giderilmesini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İşlemin günahı işlenmemiş gibi kılan sonucunun öne çıktığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Günahın etkisini ve yükünü ortadan kaldırma sonucunu korur.

bozulan yeminin gerektirdiği yükümlülüğü yerine getirme

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal günah veya yemin yükünü belirli bir karşılık ya da işlemle giderir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hak edilmiş cezayı uygulamamayı ve suçu bağışlayarak silmeyi merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Günahın sonucunu ortadan kaldırma ve onu silinmiş sayma iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda giderici karşılık veya yükümlülük belirleyicidir; komşu dalda belirleyici olan cezadan vazgeçme ve bağışlamadır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal geçmiş eylemin yükünü gideren karşılığı veya işlemi bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin günahtan dönmesini ve davranış yönünü değiştirmesini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da işlenmiş bir günahla ilişkiyi değiştiren dinî-ahlaki bir süreçtir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak yükün silinmesidir; komşu dalda odak kişinin geri dönüşü ve davranışı bırakmasıdır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi üzüm salkımının çiçeklenmeden önceki kılıfını, hurma çiçeğinin kabını ve meyveyi örten yaprağı aynı örtücü bitki yapıları kümesinde toplar; bunlar yalnızca olgun meyvenin tek tip kabuğu değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal güzel kokulu maddeyi değil, üzüm veya hurma çiçeği ile meyveyi gelişme aşamasında örten bitkisel kılıfları kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın ad biçimleri bitkisel kılıf ve kap anlamında tutulur; güzel kokulu madde, su kaynağı veya bitki anlamları bu dala alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Üzüm salkımını çiçeklenmeden önce, hurma çiçeğini ya da gelişen meyveyi örten bitkisel kılıf, kap veya yapraktır.

facets.statement: Gelişen çiçek veya meyveyi dıştan örten bitkisel kılıf ya da kap.
Üzüm salkımının çiçek öncesi kılıfı, hurma çiçeğinin kabı ve meyveyi örten yaprak farklı gönderimlerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar çiçek veya meyveyi örten bitkisel kapta birleşir; üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği ve meyve yaprağı bu üst kavramın farklı gönderimleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Üzüm ve hurma dâhil gelişen bitki bölümünü örten kap veya yaprağı genel olarak karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Örtücü bitkisel yapıyı ve çiçek ile meyve kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Söz hurma ağacından çıkan çiçek kabını gösterdiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hurma çiçeğini örten kap biçimli bitki yapısını korur.
error_profile.loses: Üzüm salkımı ve başka meyve örtülerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal üzüm salkımı, hurma çiçeği veya meyvenin dış kılıfını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnızca başaktaki tek bir tahıl tanesinin ince örtüsünü kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Bir bitki üreme yapısını dıştan örten doğal kılıf iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtülen bölüm ve yapı ölçeği farklıdır: bu dal salkım, çiçek veya meyve kabıdır; komşu dal tanenin başak içindeki ince örtüsüdür.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal örtücü kılıfın kendisini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ekinin kendi kılıfına girip korunmuş duruma gelmesini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Gelişen bitki ürününün doğal bir kılıf içinde korunması iki dalda ortaktır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal nesne adıdır; komşu dal ürünün kılıf içine girme aşamasını ve durumunu merkez alır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وسمى كافورا لأنه كفر الوليع أي غطاه (maqayis)؛ الكافور كم العنب قبل أن ينور وكافوره ورقة الذي يستره والكافور الطلع والكفرى والكوافير (ayn)؛ الكافور الطلع ووعاء طلع النخل وكذلك الكفرى (sihah)؛ الكافور اسم أكمام الثمرة التي تكفرها والكافور أكمام الثمرة (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi tek bir kavramsal tür vermek yerine aynı sözle anılan üç ayrı gönderimi sıralar: güzel kokulu bir madde, cennetteki bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki. Tanım bu nedenle birleşik bir nesne sınıfı kurmadan sözlüksel çokanlamlılık kümesi olarak düzenlenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üç gönderim birbirinin örneği değildir; dal yalnızca kaynakta aynı ad altında toplanan bu ayrı sözlük anlamlarını korur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçimin üç ayrı gönderimi birbirine karıştırılmadan verilir; meyve ve çiçek kılıfı anlamı bu dala aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Aynı sözle adlandırılan üç ayrı gönderimden oluşan bir sözlük kümesidir: güzel kokulu bir karışım maddesi, cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı ve çiçeği papatyaya benzeyen bir bitki.

facets.statement: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan bir madde.
Cennette bulunduğu belirtilen bir su kaynağı.
Çiçeği papatya çiçeğine benzeyen bir bitki.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak kanıtı güzel kokulu madde anlamını ortaklaştırır; aynı aggregate aktarım ayrıca su kaynağı ve papatyaya benzer çiçekli bitki anlamlarını ayrı gönderimler olarak kaydeder.

concept_gloss.text: koku maddesi, su kaynağı veya bitki
concept_gloss.applicability: Birbirinden ayrı üç sözlük gönderimini yapay bir ortak nesne türüne indirgemeden birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Üç ayrı gönderimin tamamını ve aralarındaki tür ayrılığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün güzel koku hazırlamada kullanılan maddeyi gösterdiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güzel kokulu karışımlarda kullanılan madde gönderimini korur.
error_profile.loses: Su kaynağı ve çiçekli bitki gönderimlerini dışarıda bırakır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın güzel kokulu madde yanında su kaynağı ve ayrı bir bitki gönderimi de vardır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güzel kokulu kökü olan belirli bitkileri ve onlardan elde edilen kokuyu adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal güzel koku veren bitkisel madde alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortak alan yalnızca koku maddesi yönüdür; gönderimler ve bu dalın öteki iki sözlük anlamı farklı olduğu için ikame edilemezler.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; yalnızca güzel kokulu bitki ve madde adayı bir facet için yararlı alan karşılaştırması sağladı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الكافور من الطيب وعين ماء في الجنة والنبات المسمى كافورا
